d: "Just when Turtleman thinks he knows what a rescue call involves, the wild has other plans! This compilation brings together a series of unpredictable wildlife encounters, from tricky snake rescues and stubborn turtle captures to raccoons, mink and other creatures that put his animal-catching skills to the test. Ernie Brown Jr., better known as Turtleman, teams up with Neal James to tackle unusual animal rescue and wild animal removal missions.
